THE CHINA PRESS, MONDAY, APRIL 28, 1930

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL
C. I. D. REGRT.
No. 1. O. D. 12.12.
Date ..29...4..- 30.

Appeal Is Made To Workers
In Labor Day Message From
The Government At Nanking

Danger Of Class Struggles Is Pointed Out And
Need To Advance Welfare Of Nation As
Whole Is Emphasized

(Kuo Min News Agency)
Nank'ng. April 27.—A Labor Day
Message to the laboring classes
throughout the country was issued
lest night by the Publicity Depart-
ment of the Central Party Head-
quarters. It explains in detail the
danger of class struggles and points
out that the only profitable means
of raising the status and promoting
the welfare of all Chinese workers
lies in the emancipation of the
Country from the woes of Militarism
and Feudalism and from the ex-
ploitation and oppression of Im-
perialism and Communism. The
workers are advised to seek their
own advancement by enhancing the
well-being of the nation as a whole
instead of creating trouble for
themselves and causing inconveni-
ence to the public. Following is a
resume of the statement:—
Labor Day, the memorable occa-
sion on which in the year 1866,
American workmen in Chicago first
started the struggle for their libera-
tion and from which dated "the
emancipation of the Western labor-
ing classes from the oppression of
the Capitalists, is indeed an occa-
sion well-deserving of our comme-
moration.
In commemorating this occasion,
it behoves all our workmen however,
firstly to understand fully the spe-
cial circumstances in which they
find themselves in China today and
secondly, to make sure of the direc-
tion in which they should concen-
trate their exertions.
In the iron grip of Imperialism
and bowed down by poverty and
weakness, China occupies today a
position not equal even to that of a
vassal or "colony" of the Powers.
The reason for this degrading posi-
tion is to be found in the continued
existence of the unequal treaties;
and the entire masses of the coun-
try, especially the workers, should
be cognizant of this humiliating
position.
It is, therefore, obvious that in
order to raise and elevate their own
status, our workers must strive for
the elevation of the position of the
entire nation. Not particularly for
the welfare of themselves, but
rather, for that of the country as a
whole, should our workers carry on
their struggle.
We should also realize that, in-
dustrially, our country is still far
behind. Due to the competition
and economic exploitation of foreign
capitalists, no less than the Handi-
craft industry have been experienc-
ing great hard hips. As regards the
manufacturing industry, even the
so-called employers themselves are
groaning under the oppression of
foreign Capitalism. Far different are
our employers from the Western
Capitalists. There does not exist in
China, as was clearly pointed out
by the late Party Leader (Dr. Sun)
any class analogous to the Capital-
ists in the West. Instead of causing
trouble for our so-called "Capital-
ists," the workmen should give the
fullest cooperation and work with
them for the promotion of native
industries and for the betterment of
our material well-being. Unless our
workmen realize this and act ac-
cordingly, they, together with their
employers, will fall prey to the
powerful foreign capitalists.
The main object of the Chinese
Communists in instigating and in-
citing class-struggles and industrial
strife, far from promoting the well-
being of the workmen, is to utilize
ignorant laborers to create a reign
of terror and to disturb peace and
order in the country. Being servile
tools of the foreign Bolsheviks, they
are forever ready to reap advant-
ages for themselves at the expense
of the laborers.
It is, indeed, needless to reiterate
that the only way of emancipating
our workmen is for them to promote
the spirit of cooperation between
Capital and Labor for the deliver-
ance of the entire nation from for-
eign economic and political ser-
vitude.
The Kuomintang has always
championed the cause of the op-
pressed people. It has never neg-
lected the welfare of the workers.
During the past few years, the Gov-
ernment has directed its efforts to-
wards the abolition of unequal trea-
ties, the restoration of tariff auton-
omy, the retrocession of foreign con-
cessions and leased territories and,
generally, the elevation of the coun-
try's status in the family of nations.
It has protected home industries,
abolished likin, re-organized and re-
adjusted taxation and promoted the
use of native products. It must be
obvious that all these activities of
the Government directly and in-
directly enhance the prestige of
Labor.
In the drafting of various Labor
Laws such as the Factory Law,
Labor Union Law and the Law for
the Settlement of Disputes between
Capital and Labor, provisions have
been made for the protection of the
interests of the workers and every
effort has also been made to promote
workers' insurance, cooperative en-
terprises among workmen and other
activities and enterprises calculated
to increase the well-being of labor-
ers.
The remnant Militarists have,
however, repeatedly embroiled the
country in disastrous civil wars,
thereby increasing the sufferings of
the workers. They should there-
fore strive, under the leadership of
the Party, for the extermination of
Militarism so that the Government
may devote itself to National Re-
construction and the betterment of
the lot of the workers in particular
and the entire people in general.—

上海公共租界
刑事调查处登记

日期：30年4月29日

南京政府五一节文告
向工人发出呼吁

指出阶级斗争之危险并
强调增进国家整体福利之必要

（国民通讯社）
南京，4月27日电。——中央党部宣传部于昨晚向全国劳工阶级发布了一份五一节文告。该文详细阐述了阶级斗争的危险，并指出，提高全体中国工人地位并促进其福利的唯一有利途径，在于使国家从军阀主义和封建主义的祸患中，以及从帝国主义和共产主义的剥削与压迫下解放出来。文告劝告工人们通过增进国家整体的福祉来谋求自身的进步，而不是自找麻烦并给公众带来不便。以下是该声明的摘要：——

劳动节是一个值得纪念的日子，1866年，芝加哥的美国工人正是在这一天首次开始了争取解放的斗争，西方劳工阶级从此得以从资本家的压迫下获得“解放”，这确实是一个值得我们纪念的日子。

在纪念这一日子时，我国所有工人首先必须充分理解他们今日在中国所处的特殊环境，其次要确定他们应集中努力的方向。

中国在帝国主义的铁腕控制下，因贫困和衰弱而弯腰屈膝，今日所处的地位甚至不及列强的附庸或“殖民地”。造成这种屈辱地位的原因在于不平等条约的持续存在；全国民众，尤其是工人，应当认识到这种屈辱的地位。

因此，显而易见，为了提高和提升他们自身的地位，我国工人必须致力于提升整个国家的地位。我国工人的斗争不应特别为了他们自身的福利，而应是为了国家整体的福利。

我们还应认识到，在工业方面，我国仍然远远落后。由于外国资本家的竞争和经济剥削，不仅手工业经历了巨大的困难，就制造业而言，即使是所谓的雇主本身也在外国资本主义的压迫下呻吟。我国的雇主与西方资本家大不相同。正如已故党的领袖（孙博士）明确指出的那样，中国并不存在类似于西方资本家的阶级。工人们不应给所谓“资本家”制造麻烦，而应给予充分合作，与他们共同努力，以促进民族工业的发展并改善我们的物质福祉。除非我国工人认识到这一点并据此行动，否则他们将与雇主一起成为强大的外国资本家的牺牲品。

中国共产党人煽动和鼓动阶级斗争及劳资纠纷的主要目的，远非促进工人的福祉，而是利用无知的劳工制造恐怖统治，扰乱国家的和平与秩序。作为外国布尔什维克的奴性工具，他们随时准备以牺牲劳工为代价来为自己谋取利益。

的确，无需赘言，解放我国工人的唯一途径是促进资本与劳工之间的合作精神，以使整个国家从外国的经济和政治奴役中解脱出来。

国民党一直捍卫被压迫人民的事业。它从未忽视工人的福利。在过去几年中，政府致力于废除不平等条约、恢复关税自主权、收回外国租界和租借地，并总体上提升国家在国际社会中的地位。政府保护了国内工业，废除了厘金，重组和调整了税收，并提倡使用国货。显而易见，政府的所有这些活动都直接或间接地提高了劳工的声望。

在起草各项劳动法，如《工厂法》、《工会法》和《劳资争议处理法》时，已作出保护工人利益的规定，并尽一切努力促进工人保险、工人合作社以及其他旨在增加劳工福祉的活动和企业。

然而，残余的军阀屡次使国家陷入灾难性的内战，从而加剧了工人的苦难。因此，他们应在党的领导下，努力消灭军阀主义，以便政府能够致力于国家建设，特别是改善工人的境遇，以及普遍改善全体人民的命运。——
